name: Problem 49 on page 235 of Mathematics: California Edition, by Carole Greenes et al.
comment: My best guess for the first differences is A008486, which would imply that the present sequence has g.f. x*(6-11*x+7*x^2+x^3)/(1-x)^3, with initial terms 6, 7, 10, 16, 25, 37, 52, 70, 91, 115, 142, 172, ... - _N. J. A. Sloane_, Oct 25 2025
reference: Carole Greenes, Miriam A. Leiva, and Bruce R. Vogeli, Mathematics: California Edition, Houghton Mifflin Company, 2002, ISBN 0-618-08179-8.
